verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows Namecheap publishing a per-TLD price list broken out by registration, renewal, and transfer; the docs are about API/RDAP/Terraform tooling, not pricing at all. One community comment (namecheap-comm-9) even suggests renewal pricing surprises are a customer concern, but no vendor pricing-page or price-list documentation is cited to confirm or deny transparency. missing for 10: a published price table or pricing page, per-TLD registration/renewal/transfer breakdown, evidence contradicting or confirming teaser-price complaints.
